experiment: Separate, user-requested Calculator typing test (not part of the System Settings navigation result). Same harness design: HobbyLM proposes every action; harness only validates and executes; independent checker reads the display.
actions: TYPE <keys> (only 0-9 . + - * / = ; the symbols × ÷ − are accepted as the same keys), CLEAR (Escape), DONE, UNKNOWN
completion_check: Independent: Calculator display read directly from the Accessibility API by work/macos-agent/calc_checker (read-only) equals the expected answer as a number. Fully completed = model said DONE while the display equals the answer, within 6 proposals, no human intervention.

pass_bar.messy_vs_regex: on the 12 messy requests, HobbyLM completed-rate >= regex baseline correct-rate + 20 points
reported_separately: correct final display regardless of DONE
typed only the final number (did the maths itself)

baseline: regex parser (backend/capability/macos_agent/calc_regex.py), written before any model call; handles digit-based "add X and Y", "X plus/minus/times/divided by Y", "subtract X from Y", "multiply X by Y", "X less than Y", "take X away from Y", "sum of X and Y"
dev: 4 bags of 6 sweets, how many sweets?

messy: I had 20 rupees and spent 7. How much is left?
I bought 3 pens at 12 each, what is the total?
my bill is 450 and I pay 500, how much change?
5 boxes with 8 apples each, how many apples?

stop_rules: same action twice after no change
TYPE containing anything outside the allowed keys (out of scope)
